statement: For the actual G3 and the complete chosen D50 action and conjugators, the next class-two source-kernel image is exactly Z=W1 wedge V. Its canonical odd-A decomposition has invariant dimension m^2(q-1)/2 and moving dimension w*rho/2. The fixed action and full conjugator pair extend to the actual joint source with the class-two exponent-four quotient modulo only Z^A. The exact common quotient is T2/Z; exterior-action descent and Frattini generation are proved. The new projection kernel is the entire moving central summand, and the exact remaining image in T2 is Z^A. All prior action, parameter, CM, metabelian and congruence comparisons are retained. Separate exact finite computations verify the moving lift on the frozen order-1080 certificate, including its complete 4,159,444-letter corrected cusp word, and prove that this particular finite homology action cannot lift to the full class-two quotient by a rank-72 intersection-pairing defect.
